eval_tickets.title: MeridianConnect drops every few minutes
eval_tickets.description: From home, MeridianConnect disconnects about every five minutes. Ordinary websites still work and my phone hotspot keeps the VPN stable, so I can use that workaround for now.
eval_tickets.difficulty_note: Direct VPN symptom with one affected user and an effective alternate network.

eval_tickets.title: Remote access unavailable for dispatch team
eval_tickets.description: Eighteen remote dispatch employees cannot establish MeridianConnect sessions. Normal internet works, no alternate connection reaches the dispatch system, and the morning operation is stopped.
eval_tickets.difficulty_note: A VPN outage affecting at least 10 users and stopping a critical operation meets the explicit P1/critical threshold.

eval_tickets.title: Account locked after password attempts
eval_tickets.description: I tried my password five times and now the identity portal says my account is locked. I have no customer deadline today and can continue offline work.
eval_tickets.difficulty_note: The lockout count and absence of a deadline directly match routine account recovery.

eval_tickets.title: Lost phone and cannot approve MFA
eval_tickets.description: My enrolled phone was lost during my commute. I have no recovery code and cannot approve MFA, so I cannot sign in to any company service.
eval_tickets.difficulty_note: A lost factor with no recovery method is explicitly high-urgency account access owned by IT Security.

eval_tickets.title: Cracked laptop screen
eval_tickets.description: I dropped my assigned laptop and the screen is cracked. It is safe and still works through my dock and external monitor, so I have a usable workaround.
eval_tickets.difficulty_note: Physical laptop damage with a safe alternate display is a single-user degraded hardware case.

eval_tickets.title: Laptop will not power on before customer workshop
eval_tickets.description: My company laptop will not power on after charging and I have no other managed device. I lead a confirmed customer workshop in ninety minutes.
eval_tickets.difficulty_note: One unusable managed device with no alternate before a confirmed customer event meets the high-urgency hardware rule.

eval_tickets.title: Need one analytics SaaS seat next month
eval_tickets.description: Please assign one catalog analytics license for a new project that starts next month. My manager approved the business need and there is no current work interruption.
eval_tickets.difficulty_note: A planned catalog seat with no present impact is explicitly a low-urgency licensing request.

eval_tickets.title: Expired design license blocks client delivery
eval_tickets.description: My approved design application says its paid seat expired. I am the only affected user and cannot export the customer package due in two hours.
eval_tickets.difficulty_note: The application reports an expired seat and a confirmed near-term customer deadline.

eval_tickets.title: Desktop mail is not syncing
eval_tickets.description: Meridian Mail on my laptop has not synced for an hour, but the web client works and I can send and receive there. No one else on my team is affected.
eval_tickets.difficulty_note: A single-user mail client issue with a functioning web workaround is the guide's P3 example.

eval_tickets.title: Meridian Mail outage across both offices
eval_tickets.description: At least forty employees in both offices cannot open Meridian Mail or send messages. The operations mailbox has no alternate and dispatch updates are stopped.
eval_tickets.difficulty_note: The report identifies more than 10 users and a critical operational mailbox with no alternate.

eval_tickets.title: Entered password on suspicious email page
eval_tickets.description: I opened a link in an unexpected benefits email and entered my Meridian password before noticing the address was wrong. I have not seen an unknown sign-in yet.
eval_tickets.difficulty_note: Credential disclosure without confirmed unauthorized access is explicitly a high-urgency P2 security incident.

eval_tickets.title: Prepare standard IT setup for new employee
eval_tickets.description: A new support analyst starts in three weeks. The approved workforce record is complete; please coordinate the standard identity, laptop, MFA, and catalog application setup.
eval_tickets.difficulty_note: A complete onboarding request submitted well ahead of the start date is routine Service Desk coordination.

eval_tickets.title: Cannot reach ERP from home
eval_tickets.description: The ERP will not open from home. Ordinary websites work, but MeridianConnect never finishes connecting and shows a tunnel timeout, so I cannot test the ERP itself.
eval_tickets.difficulty_note: The named application suggests Business Applications, but the evidence says the VPN tunnel itself never forms.

eval_tickets.title: Password works but new phone cannot approve sign-in
eval_tickets.description: I changed phones yesterday. My password is accepted, then sign-in waits for an approval on the erased old phone. I have no saved recovery code and payroll closes this morning.
eval_tickets.difficulty_note: The ticket mentions a password, but successful first-factor validation and an unavailable old phone identify MFA recovery.

eval_tickets.title: Camera missing in every meeting app
eval_tickets.description: My external camera is not detected in TeamSpace or the operating-system camera test, though TeamSpace itself loads and coworkers can join meetings. I can dial in without video.
eval_tickets.difficulty_note: Meeting vocabulary points toward collaboration, but failure outside the application and a dial-in workaround make this hardware.

eval_tickets.title: Two seats show subscription expired
eval_tickets.description: Two analysts see 'subscription expired' in the approved forecasting application. Other licensed users can still open it, and both blocked analysts need it for today's forecast review.
eval_tickets.difficulty_note: Multiple affected users could suggest an outage, but the explicit seat-expiration message and unaffected licensed users make licensing primary.

eval_tickets.title: Odd calendar invitation asked me to sign in
eval_tickets.description: A calendar invitation from an unknown sender opened a page asking for my company password. I closed it without entering anything, but three teammates received the same invitation.
eval_tickets.difficulty_note: The delivery mechanism is a calendar, but the unexpected credential page makes security the owning category.

eval_tickets.title: URGENT: cafeteria menu request
eval_tickets.description: Please add more vegetarian options to the third-floor cafeteria menu. This is urgent to me, but no technology service, account, device, or company data is affected.
eval_tickets.difficulty_note: The topic is outside the IT corpus and an unsupported urgency claim plus existing P1 must not force a specialist route.

eval_tickets.title: Everything is broken
eval_tickets.description: My computer thing is not right. Fix it ASAP.
eval_tickets.difficulty_note: The vague description supplies no observable impact or evidence for hardware or any other specialist category.

eval_tickets.title: P1 urgent request for optional mouse
eval_tickets.description: I need a second wireless mouse for a project that starts next month. My current mouse works and I marked this P1 because I would like it ordered today.
eval_tickets.difficulty_note: A functioning current device and next-month need make this a low-urgency hardware request despite the P1 claim.

demo_tickets.title: VPN timeout before afternoon customer demo
demo_tickets.description: MeridianConnect times out from my home network while ordinary websites work. I have a customer demonstration at 2 p.m. and no approved alternate connection.

demo_tickets.title: Need access after phone replacement
demo_tickets.description: My old authenticator phone was erased during replacement. My password works, but I have no recovery code and cannot approve the second factor.

demo_tickets.title: Suspicious invoice attachment opened
demo_tickets.description: I opened an unexpected invoice attachment and then saw a command window flash. I disconnected from Wi-Fi and have not deleted the message.

demo_tickets.title: Request project planning license
demo_tickets.description: My manager approved one catalog project-planning SaaS seat for work beginning in two weeks. The cost center and business purpose are available.

demo_tickets.title: New starter has no prepared laptop
demo_tickets.description: Our new analyst starts today and their identity is ready, but the onboarding checklist shows no laptop assigned. They have no alternate managed device.
